arguments.subject: Order PO-9522
arguments.body:
Dear Northwind Bearings Ltd,

Please find attached our order PO-9522. We require delivery by 12 December 2026. The total value of the order is 1,352.10 EUR.

Could Ruth Sawyer please confirm this order in writing?

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
Acme Components
